onsiteNote: Friday afternoon to Saturday evening every other week in Chicago, with some Sunday classes, plus four intensive weeks a program, including orientation and Global Network Week in Evanston.

figureNotes.campusLat: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.campusLon: Derived from campusAddress (approximate, from the street address).
figureNotes.tuitionUsd: Kellogg's own estimated-expenses total for 2026-2027: tuition $205,486 plus required food and housing $42,986, billed by Kellogg in six quarters of $41,412. Food and housing is required of every student. Kellogg says tuition has historically risen 3-4% a year.
figureNotes.cohortMedianExperienceYears: Average published for the September 2024 and January 2025 Chicago and Miami cohorts (combined), with a mid-80% range of 9 to 23 years; no median or breakdown is published.
figureNotes.onsiteDaysPerYear: Counted from the January 2027 first-year Chicago calendar: 6 days of orientation (January 19-24), 14 class sessions (10 of 3 days, 4 of 2 days: 38 days, counting every listed date), a 5-day intensive week (June 21-25) and 5 days of Global Network Week in Evanston: 54 days. Some listed Sundays may have no class. The second-year calendar is not published, so year 1 stands for both.
figureNotes.residencyCount: Counted from the January 2027 first-year Chicago calendar: orientation, 14 class sessions, the intensive week and Global Network Week (17 trips).
figureNotes.longestStretchDays: Orientation programming, January 19 to 24, 2027; Global Network Week is 5 days for U.S.-campus students.
